spec.question: We are reviewing a proposed inclusion-policy change: InclusionLevel.NOT_IN_NAV would no longer count as production-included, and would count as excluded for diagnostics and preview draft marking. Concretely, is_included would be true only above NOT_IN_NAV, and is_excluded would be true at or below NOT_IN_NAV. The enum values, pattern classification, is_in_serve, and navigation-eligibility predicates would remain unchanged. Which existing tests would newly fail? Reply with a lexicographically sorted JSON list of pytest node IDs.
